text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ahahaha...! Jeez, that was seriously 
hilarious...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Awa-wa, please don't laugh so much~! It's 
embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry... Ehehehehe! I was just so 
happy, I couldn't help it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because, really. You decorated the dorm 
room specifically because today is my 
birthday, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, yeah, I guess... uh, it kind of 
feels like I just hung up every flashy 
good luck charm I had on hand, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, it went beyond 'festive' 
and ended up as a slightly 'crazy' space, 
which gave everyone a huge laugh first 
thing in the morning, though...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, Fuku-chan-senpai went out of her 
way to celebrate for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's fun, it's interesting, and of course 
it makes me happy~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Geez, if anyone's gonna cry, it 
should be me, Fuku-chan-senpai!
